title: Frame UV Lab
user: 2D game artists and shader-capable developers who need a visual, reliable way to apply per-frame effects to sprite sheets and UI icons without hand-deriving UV math.
smallest_useful_product: A local web lab that imports a sheet and frame map, previews common UV-aware effects over any selected frame, and exports annotated GLSL snippets plus generic atlas JSON.
success_measure: Users produce an effect preview and compile-ready UV constants for a 16-frame sheet in under ten minutes without editing normalized coordinates by hand.
constraints: Keep art local; use only original/open sample assets; label generated shader code as an example requiring engine-side validation.
